text:
incident-bot: ALERT: apac1 primary GPU pool rpool-23 queue depth spike > 1200 (5m avg) and autoscale failed to provision. Error: quota_exceeded. Throttling new requests. severity=high :rotating_light:
Maya (SRE): acked. paging Raj now.
Raj (oncall): on it, grabbing logs + looking at autoscaler. first glance: scale attempt at 2054321960 -> failed with cloud provider 403 Quota.
Lex (Infra Eng): can we spillover to eu-west1 fallback pool? routing policy allows region spillover but KV cache coldstart cost will be high.
Sam (Runtime): routing policy currently set to prefer same-region then tiered fallback. I can flip temporary policy to force-spillover->eu-west1 but need signoff for degraded SLO for APAC customers. Also reminder: some models are pinned to specific quantized variants in apac1, might get model-variant mismatch errors.
Nina (Support): getting customer tickets for timeouts from 3 enterprise tenants in APAC. Error rate ~6% and visible latency 5-12s for streaming. We should notify account teams.
Chris (Pager): estimated impact: 400 active requests failing for these tenants. Paging product for possible mitigation script.
Maya (SRE): triage notes: autoscaler logs show provisioning attempts hit quota limit on GPUs for our cloud project: "Quota 'NVIDIA_T4_GPUS' exceeded". Also noticed controller retries 3x then gives up.
Maya (SRE): quick mitigation options: 1) force-route new traffic to eu-west1 fallback (fast) 2) manual ramp of reserved nodes in apac1 using org reserve capacity (slower, requires cloud quota override) 3) degrade feature set (disable function-calling / long-context models) to reduce slot consumption.
Raj (oncall): option 1 preferred to reduce immediate customer impact. initiate forced spillover and create incident page for quota request.
Sam (Runtime): executing routing override now. runbook command:
```
rdw route override --from-region=apac1 --to-region=eu-west1 --pool-filter=low-latency-fallback --duration=30m --reason="autoscale quota_exceeded apac1"
```
Sam (Runtime): override submitted, traffic shift starting. monitoring: apac1 ingress dropped ~65% of new requests in last 30s as they're steered; eu-west1 CPU/GPU load spiking but within reserved headroom.
incident-bot: ACTION: manual routing override applied by Sam (Runtime) at 2054322140. 
Nina (Support): posting customer-facing note to affected accounts: short blurb + mitigation steps. pinging account teams.
Lex (Infra Eng): note: model-variant mismatch surfaced during canary traffic to eu-west1 for two customer endpoints. I'm pushing a transparent fallback to model-compatible variant to avoid immediate 500s:
```
api:
  routing_fallback_variants: ["v1-quantized-fast", "v1-quantized-compat"]
```
Lex (Infra Eng): also starting a quota request with cloud provider, ETA unknown (requested emergency quota bump).
Maya (SRE): while spillover in effect, I'll attempt manual warm-up of a small reserve pool in apac1 from our reserved account: initiating attach-reserve -> rpool-23 +10 nodes (subject to quota approval).
Maya (SRE): command:
```
rdw pool scale --pool-id=rpool-23 --region=apac1 --target-instances=50 --reason="emergency attach reserve"
```
Maya (SRE): pool scale API returned accepted but cloud API returned 403 on provisioning step. looks like reserve attach blocked by same GPU quota.
Raj (oncall): so quota is the blocker. Two parallel lanes: keep spillover to reduce impact; push quota with provider; and evaluate temporary feature degradation to free slots.
Sam (Runtime): quick traffic-steering note: we're disabling function-calling and long-context models for new APAC requests to reduce slot-time per request. config applied: `max_context_tokens=2048`, `function_calling_enabled=false` for apac1-inbound.
Nina (Support): marked impacted customers as "degraded" in CRM and sent update.
Chris (Pager): monitoring: error rate in apac1 dropped from 6% -> 1.1% after spillover plus feature degradation. latency for affected customers now 2-5s (eu-west1).
Lex (Infra Eng): provider responded to quota request: emergency increase approval pending, estimating 2-3 hours. escalated to provider urgent channel.
Maya (SRE): next steps: keep forced spillover for 1h, continue quota push, attempt to gracefully onboard reserve once quota available. sam, please watch eu-west1 tail capacity and enable auto-fallback to apac1 when healthy.
Sam (Runtime): will setup health-check and auto-fallback policy:
```
rdw route policy set --name=apac-spillback --criteria='apac1_queue<100 && apac1_error_rate<0.5' --action=spillback
```
Maya (SRE): handoff to day team in 30m. Raj you can wrap up on-call after handoff.
Raj (oncall): noted. creating incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-205432 (draft). assigning Sam as PM for mitigation follow-up, Lex for infra root cause, Maya for runbook updates, Nina for comms.
incident-bot: UPDATE: incident severity -> SEV2, start_ts=2054321987.
Maya (SRE): afternoon update: provider granted a partial quota increase for 12 GPUs; not enough to fully restore target, but enough to bring pool to +12 nodes. scaling attach succeeded for 12 nodes at 2054325600.
Sam (Runtime): applying gradual spillback: returning 20% of traffic to apac1 to validate. monitoring closely.
Chris (Pager): metrics look good: queue depth down to 80, error rate apac1 0.4%, overall customer impact minimal.
Nina (Support): sent final customer update: brief summary + ETA for full restoration (TBD). customers acknowledged.
Maya (SRE): final ops update at 2054330400: traffic fully measured, autoscaler back to normal behavior now that partial quota applied; spillover policy removed at 2054330200. queue stabilized and we are closing immediate mitigation. Postmortem owners assigned.
Sam (Runtime): post-incident action items: 1) automate emergency routing override with safe defaults, 2) add quota preflight checks in autoscaler, 3) add synthetic canary traffic to fallback pools for coldstart warm-up.
Lex (Infra Eng): infra action items: 1) request increased regional GPU quota baseline for apac1, 2) improve reservation attach error handling to surface quota-specific guidance, 3) document model variant fallback mapping.
Nina (Support): comms action items: customer notification template ready.
Maya (SRE): closing thread — will publish incident timeline and RCA tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
